title: 3dFDR
description: A tool for applying False Discovery Rate (FDR) thresholding to voxelwise statistics in 3D functional datasets.

mask_file.description: Use mask values from file mname. If file mname contains more than 1 sub-brick, the mask sub-brick must be specified. Generally should be used to avoid counting non-brain voxels.
mask_file.title: Mask file

mask_threshold.description: Only voxels whose corresponding mask value is greater than or equal to the specified value in absolute terms will be considered. Default is 1.
mask_threshold.title: Mask threshold

constant_type.description: Set constant c(N): 1 for independent p-values (default) or sum(1/i, i=1,...,N) for any joint distribution.
constant_type.title: Constant type

list.description: Write sorted list of voxel q-values to screen.
list.title: List flag

prefix.description: Use 'pname' for the output dataset prefix name.
prefix.title: Output prefix

mode_option.description: Use the old or new mode of operation. 'new' is now the default.
mode_option.title: Mode option

pmask.description: Ignore p=1 voxels (default in new mode).
pmask.title: P-mask flag

nopmask.description: Count p=1 voxels (default in old mode).
nopmask.title: No P-mask flag

force.description: Force conversion of all sub-bricks, treating them as p-values.
force.title: Force flag

float.description: Force the output of z-scores in floating point format.
float.title: Float flag

qval.description: Force the output of q-values rather than z-scores.
qval.title: Q-value flag
